annotations.title: Get API X402 programacao by slug

description:
The last seven days of the channel's schedule in one call, for an agent, paid per call, with no account.
Up to seven days of the channel's schedule in one response, sold per call to agents without an account, pass or prior allowance. The free API `GET /api/programacao/:slug/:dia` gives one day per request. A missing channel or day, or unavailable history, returns an error before payment is offered. When a schedule is available, an unpaid request receives 402 with the price. A paid request receives the week in the same response, with payment details in `cobranca`.

slug.description: Stored slug of the channel, from the collection.
